speaker: Mr Darryl David
text: asked the Minister for Education (Schools) (a) in the past five years, how many parents have provided false information to secure a place for their child in a school; (b) how are such cases handled by the authorities; and (c) whether the child in question is allowed to remain in the school that he or she has been enrolled in when the parents have been found guilty of providing false information.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: First, in such cases, does the Ministry or the school provide counselling services for the child that is affected by this rather unfortunate turn of circumstances?

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Does the Ministry then follow up to see whether the child is adjusting well in the new school?

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: My concern, of course, is coming from the perspective of the welfare of the child.

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: After all, he or she is still the centre of the purpose of education.
